title: Q-MINO: A Minimal-Norm Method for Quantization-Aware Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.00738v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Straight-Through Estimator (STE) is a widely used heuristic for Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), but its surrogate gradients can exhibit substantial mismatch with the underlying quantized objective, leading to noisy updates and parameter oscillations, particularly in ultra-low-bit regimes. We propose the Quantization-Aware Minimal-Norm Optimizer (Q-MINO), a temporal bundle method that combines gradient consensus, state-drift regularization, and an alignment constraint to construct stabilized, minimum-norm update directions from recent optimization states. Q-MINO solves the resulting constrained subproblem using a warm-started Frank--Wolfe procedure with a feasible fallback initialization. Theoretically, via a stochastic Lyapunov Kurdyka--\L ojasiewicz (KL) framework, we show that Q-MINO achieves asymptotic neighborhood convergence. Moreover, we detail numerical experiments with Q-MINO at various quantizations.

translated_title: Q-MINO：一种用于量化感知训练的最小范数方法
translated_abstract: 直通估计器（STE）是量化感知训练（QAT）中广泛使用的一种启发式方法，但其替代梯度可能与底层量化目标存在显著的不匹配，导致更新过程充满噪声和参数振荡，尤其是在超低比特场景下。我们提出了量化感知最小范数优化器（Q-MINO），这是一种时间束方法，通过结合梯度共识、状态漂移正则化和对齐约束，从最近的优化状态中构建稳定的最小范数更新方向。Q-MINO使用带可行回退初始化的温启动Frank-Wolfe过程来求解由此产生的约束子问题。在理论上，通过随机Lyapunov Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz（KL）框架，我们证明了Q-MINO能够实现渐近邻域收敛。此外，我们详细介绍了Q-MINO在各种量化设置下的数值实验。
tldr: Q-MINO通过结合梯度共识、状态漂移正则化和对齐约束构建稳定的最小范数更新方向，解决了STE在量化感知训练中替代梯度失配导致的噪声更新和参数振荡问题，并在理论上证明了其渐近邻域收敛性。
